# Statements GetObjects sends at this depth, sorted. Regenerate with -update.

## no filters: 3 statement(s), 2 IN ACCOUNT
    <queries/get_objects_dbschemas.sql>
        CATALOG="%" DB_SCHEMA="%" TABLE="%" COLUMN="%" PK_QUERY_ID="" FK_QUERY_ID="" UNIQUE_QUERY_ID="" SHOW_DB_QUERY_ID="<id>" SHOW_SCHEMA_QUERY_ID="<id>" SHOW_TABLE_QUERY_ID="" SHOW_COLUMNS_QUERY_ID=""
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ DATABASES IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS IN ACCOUNT

## plain names DB/SCH/TBL: 1 statement(s), 0 IN ACCOUNT
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ SCHEMAS LIKE 'SCH' IN DATABASE "DB"
